svg.title: Did this change make the agent less reliable, and what broke?
svg.desc: arci: agent-reliability-ci, regression gate for stochastic agents. Did this change make the agent less reliable, and what broke? A frozen experiment, an exact verdict with its uncertainty, and a failure case you can replay offline. Evidence card: Seeded retry demo, 200 trials per arm, timeout on the first reserve call. A 192/200, B 132/200. Bounds on the difference [−0.405, −0.183], margin −0.10. VERDICT: BLOCK (exit 1); 3 injected faults reduced to 1, 1-minimal; offline replay REPRODUCED. B is A with one retry removed. Source: docs/results/retry-demo-n200.md.
